2608.25449.title: MathAdv: What Theorem Provers Know, Reason, Formalize, and Generalize
2608.25449.paper_summary: Formal theorem proving enables machine-verifiable evaluation of mathematical reasoning, yet existing benchmarks often emphasize aggregate proof accuracy, concentrate on a narrow range of mathematics, and provide limited evidence of robustness to equivalent reformulations. We introduce MathAdv, a diagnostic benchmark spanning 13 domains across undergraduate- and graduate-level mathematics. Alongside Lean 4 theorem proving, MathAdv provides up to three auxiliary tasks: multiple-choice questions that probe mathematical knowledge, fill-in-the-blank problems that isolate informal reasoning, and expert-crafted transformations that test robustness to problem presentation. Our evaluation of contemporary theorem provers yields four findings: formalization remains a major bottleneck; performance varies substantially across mathematical domains; natural-language guidance helps general-purpose LLMs but can hinder proof-specialized models; and mathematically equivalent reformulations expose substantial robustness limitations. Together, these results show how component-wise evaluation can reveal model capabilities and failure modes that aggregate theorem-proving accuracy obscures. The dataset and evaluation scripts are available at https://github.com/margotyjx/MathAdv.git.
2608.25449.paper_summary_zh: 正式的定理證明使機器可驗證的數學推理評估成為可能，然而現有的基準往往強調整體證明的準確性，集中於狹窄的數學範疇，並提供有限的證據來證明對等價重構的穩健性。我們介紹了 MathAdv，一個涵蓋本科和研究生數學的 13 個領域的診斷基準。除了 Lean 4 定理證明外，MathAdv 還提供多達三個輔助任務：探查數學知識的選擇題、隔離非正式推理的填空題，以及測試對問題呈現的穩健性的專家設計轉換。我們對當代定理證明者的評估得出了四個發現：形式化仍然是一個主要瓶頸；不同數學領域的表現差異顯著；自然語言指導有助於通用 LLM，但可能會妨礙專注於證明的模型；而數學上等價的重構則暴露出顯著的穩健性限制。這些結果共同顯示了逐部評估如何揭示模型的能力和失效模式，而這些在整體定理證明準確性中則被掩蓋。數據集和評估腳本可在 https://github.com/margotyjx/MathAdv.git 獲得。
